get.description: Required scopes: No additional scope. Supported filters: No filters. Reports effective scopes and limits. Unsupported non-default filters return 400. Lists accept limit (1–100, default 25) and cursor. Cursors are opaque and bound to integration, scope, resource and filters; reuse with unchanged filters. history defaults to CURRENT. Defaults may appear in meta.filters even if inapplicable to this endpoint. 401 invalid/expired/revoked credential; 403 missing scope; 404 foreign or hidden resource; 429 rate/concurrency limit with Retry-After; 503 controls or access auditing unavailable. Responses use Cache-Control: no-store. Limits: 60 requests/key/minute, 300/conference/minute; 2 concurrent/key, 10/conference. Pre-authentication abuse limit: 60/IP/minute.

info.title: OpenConferences read-only Bot API
info.description: Conference-scoped read access. All timestamps are UTC. Names and contacts are omitted without explicit identity/contact scopes. Review content, scores, conflicts, invitations, payments, files and mutations are excluded. Each page is a consistent read snapshot; different pages may observe concurrent updates. A missing historical submittedAt is null, not an estimate. Secrets are shown only once by the human management API.

BotKey.description: ocbot_v1.<public-key-id>.<secret>; expires in at most 90 days. One conference per key. Never pass keys in query strings.
